q: What do we know about feat-pbs-timing-v2 in the payment-behavior-segments project?
a: Days from statement close to payment, binned into four bands per account, added in January 2026. It lifts seed-to-seed ARI for the GMM from 0.74 to 0.81 (exp-403) and is an input to pbs-gmm-v3.

q: What came of exp-404 in the payment-behavior-segments project?
a: exp-404 tested HDBSCAN: 31% of accounts were labelled noise and nine clusters moved between seeds. dec-pbs-no-hdbscan dropped it and kept the GMM line.

q: What does pbs-gmm-v3 use as inputs in the payment-behavior-segments project?
a: Pay ratio, minimum-payment flag, cash-advance share, interest paid and timing-v2 features, on the ds-pbs-payments-12m and ds-pbs-statement-balances sources over the ds-pbs-frame-h1-2025 frame. It has five components.

q: What is the current segmentation model in the payment-behavior-segments project?
a: pbs-gmm-v3, a five-component Gaussian mixture (transactor, revolver, minimum-payer, cash-heavy, dormant) adopted in January 2026. It supersedes pbs-gmm-v2 and the six-cluster kmeans run.

q: What seed-to-seed ARI does pbs-gmm-v3 reach in the payment-behavior-segments project, and on what sample?
a: ARI 0.81 between seeds and silhouette 0.42, on a 200k-account random sample of the 1.38M-account frame (ds-pbs-frame-h1-2025).

q: Why did the payment-behavior-segments project move from six segments to five?
a: The six-cluster kmeans run split the minimum-payer group into two near-identical clusters, and seed ARI was only 0.58. With GMM and timing features five components were stable (ARI 0.81), so fnd-pbs-five-segments superseded fnd-pbs-six-segments.
